patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed hero image with large, centered typography, transitioning to a unique, vertically stacked 'word cloud' section, and then to a full-width dark footer.
Prominent use of an elegant, high-contrast serif font for brand name and key conceptual words, paired with a subtle, light sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A stark, high-contrast palette of white and dark grey, with black text, creating a sophisticated and minimal aesthetic.

The hero text scales significantly and the background image parallaxes as the user scrolls. The page then transitions with a full-page reveal to a dark footer section, suggesting a scroll-snapping behavior.
A distinctive 'list of words' section acts as a visual index or mood board, presenting a poetic array of concepts central to the brand's philosophy.

technique_notes: Utilize a smooth scrolling library like locomotive-scroll to create a subtle parallax effect on the hero background image and a scaling animation for the main hero text. Implement full-page section transitions or scroll-snapping to smoothly reveal distinct content blocks, such as the dark footer, after the initial hero section.

Employ an elegant, high-contrast serif font for large headings and brand elements, ensuring generous letter-spacing for readability. Complement this with a lightweight sans-serif for smaller text, maintaining a clean and airy feel.
Design with ample whitespace and full-bleed imagery to create a sense of luxury and spaciousness, allowing key typographic elements to stand out.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, elegant serif headings (~10x body text) with generous letter-spacing, contrasted with small, light sans-serif body text and labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — very generous vertical spacing in hero and conceptual word lists, with a balanced density in the footer.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the 'list of words' section, which functions as a poetic, conceptual index rather than a traditional content block. This, combined with the dramatic full-page scroll transitions and elegant typography, creates a highly editorial and artistic brand experience.
